Subject: Private deployment design & ops review — VPC / air-gap coordination

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, we should schedule a focused design + ops review to walk through the VPC topology, firewall/bastion requirements, and the specifics for the potential air-gapped/on-prem footprint. Goal: surface blockers for a proof-of-concept and confirm the list of artifacts we need to collect before the engagement kickoff.

Proposed 60–90 minute slots (PDT):
- Tue 24 Mar, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 25 Mar, 14:00–15:30
- Thu 26 Mar, 09:00–10:30

Suggested internal attendees: Jordan (sales), Marissa (solutions), Dev (security/compliance), Maya (runtime engineering). Please tell us who from Acme should join (network ops, security, cloud infra). If you have a preferred time among the slots above, we’ll send a calendar invite.

Also attaching a short checklist we use for private deployments (network ports, expected egress patterns, KMS/HSM footprint, audit log retention). If you have a red-team or compliance packet to share ahead of time, please add it to the thread or the Drive link below.

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/ops/RDW-3129

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: Private deployment design & ops review — VPC / air-gap coordination

Jordan —

Thanks, this looks great. We definitely want a technical run-through before committing to any on-prem changes. Please include our network and security leads: Tom Reyes (Network Lead) and our infrastructure alias (infra@acmehealth.com).

Two items up front:
1) We will likely require an air-gap option for one of our regulated clusters — that means no outbound internet from the cluster except for an approved update channel. Is Redwood able to support a pulled-image update process via an internal registry?
2) We need to confirm encryption at rest with our HSM provider and whether tokens/keys ever transit Redwood-managed control planes.

Prefer Wed 25 Mar at 14:00 PT if that still works. I attached a simple topology snapshot from our internal network team for context.

Attachment: acme-network-topology.png (PNG, 220 KB)

Best,
Olivia Park
Product Security Manager | Acme Health
olivia.park@acmehealth.com | +1 212-555-0124

Olivia —

Wed 25 Mar, 14:00 PT works for us — I’ll send an invite for a 90-minute block to give us time for the topology, the air-gap questions, and a short run of possible deployment patterns.

Action items for the session (so we arrive prepared):
- Acme: share any SSO/KMS/HSM vendor names and expected token/key rotation cadence; confirm any regulatory constraints that would prevent outbound telemetry.
- Acme: confirm whether the internal registry will be reachable from a bastion host or whether images will be pre-staged on air-gapped media.
- Redwood: Marissa to present network/firewall port requirements and required NAT/bastion patterns.
- Redwood: Dev to cover key management and audit log architecture.
- Redwood: Maya to review runtime resource expectations (GPU/CPU, disk for model shards).

I’ve attached a short topology cheat sheet for our internal presenters so we don’t wait on slides during the call. If you need to shift the time, let me know — otherwise I’ll create a calendar invite and include the links below.

Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf

Looping in a couple of internal notes ahead of the Wed session:

Marissa — can you prepare a one-page runbook that outlines the ports/outbound dependencies and an optional configuration for an internal registry pull? If Acme is doing pre-staging we should outline the verification steps we’ll do on any image media.

Maya — I’ll need estimated I/O (MB/s) and KV cache disk sizing for the model families they expect to run (they mentioned a high-throughput genomics pipeline on the call). If you can give ranges that will help our network ops estimate egress/backhaul sizing.

Acme — we’ll request a short NDA addendum for privileged access to your staging environment (standard for air-gapped POCs). I can send a template; please let me know the point of contact for legal/compliance (if different from Olivia).

Proposed confirmed time: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 14:00–15:30 PT — calendar invite will follow from Jordan.

Thanks,
